- REALITY: ML-DSA-65 check of the server (`mldsa65Verify`, `pqv` in links)
- Port knocking: SPA step, one signed packet that cannot be replayed (`PORT/spa:KEY`)
- Port knocking works for profiles on Yggdrasil addresses
